findings.title: Create A as a descendant of the base commit
findings.body: `git commit-tree "$architecture_tree"` creates A with no parent, so A is an unrelated root commit even though it has B's tree. The documented restored-run proof later requires B to be an ancestor of the Buster source; a source based on the admitted architecture A cannot satisfy that condition, and source admission may reject A's revision proof before then. Create A with `-p "$RELEASE_COMMIT"` so it remains a distinct immutable object while preserving the required B→A ancestry.
